The '''Republic Embassy''' was the diplomatic mission of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the [[Ahto City Civil Authority]] on the neutral [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the amphibious [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]], in order to negotiate [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] exportation from the officially neutral planet by the diplomat [[Roland Wann]].

==History==
The Galactic Republic secretly built the illegal [[Hrakert Station]], accessible from the Embassy by [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]], and were assisted by several Selkath&mdash;those who understood that the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] would enslave the Selkath if they conquered Manaan. The Sith captured a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with knowledge of the Station, but before the Sith could extract the information, the redeemed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], sent by Roland Wann, took the information and brought it back to the Republic Embassy. In return, Roland Wann allowed Revan to take a submersible to the Hrakert Station and search for a [[Star Map]], where Revan discovered that a creature called the [[Progenitor]], which guarded the Star Map, had turned the Selkath insane. Revan was able to calm the Progenitor by destroying the Republic machinery, and made it to the Star Map. Sometime later, the Selkath razed the embassy to the ground.
